properties.rule: zlib.h: deflateInit/deflateInit2 'must be called before any other compression function'; every deflate-side routine takes the initialized stream and deflateEnd frees it, so after deflateEnd nothing may touch the stream until it is initialized again.
properties.formula: (!def_use W def_init_ok) & G(def_end -> X(!def_use W def_init_ok))

def_use.meaning: a routine that operates on the deflate stream is about to be called

def_end.meaning: deflateEnd is about to be called

examples.reason: every use follows a successful init with no end in between
init failed, the stream is not initialized

properties.rule: zlib.h: inflateInit/inflateInit2 'must be called before any other decompression function'; inflateEnd frees the stream, so nothing may touch it afterwards until it is initialized again.
properties.formula: (!inf_use W inf_init_ok) & G(inf_end -> X(!inf_use W inf_init_ok))

inf_use.meaning: a routine that operates on the inflate stream is about to be called

inf_end.meaning: inflateEnd is about to be called

examples.reason: all uses follow a successful init

properties.rule: zlib.h: inflateBackInit 'must be called before any other inflateBack routine'; inflateBack returns Z_STREAM_ERROR for an uninitialized stream and inflateBackEnd frees the state, so no inflateBack routine may run between inflateBackEnd and the next successful inflateBackInit.
properties.formula: (!back_use W back_init_ok) & G(back_end -> X(!back_use W back_init_ok))

back_use.meaning: inflateBack or inflateBackEnd is about to be called

back_end.meaning: inflateBackEnd is about to be called

examples.reason: inflateBack may be repeated on an initialized stream

properties.rule: zlib.h deflateSetDictionary: it 'can be called ... immediately after deflateInit, deflateInit2 or deflateReset, before any call of deflate'. Once deflate has been called, the dictionary may not be set until the stream is reset or re-initialized.

deflate_called.meaning: deflate is about to be called

set_dict.meaning: deflateSetDictionary is about to be called

def_fresh.meaning: the stream was just initialized or reset

examples.reason: dictionary set right after init and again right after reset
dictionary set after deflate already consumed data

properties.rule: zlib.h: every gz* routine takes the gzFile returned by a successful gzopen/gzopen64/gzdopen; gzclose, and gzclose_r/gzclose_w when they succeed, free it. gzclose_r/gzclose_w on a handle of the wrong mode return Z_STREAM_ERROR and leave it open (gzread.c gzclose_r, gzwrite.c gzclose_w).
properties.formula: (!gz_use W gz_open_ok) & G(gz_closed -> X(!gz_use W gz_open_ok))

gz_open_ok.meaning: gzopen, gzopen64 or gzdopen returned a non-NULL gzFile

gz_use.meaning: a routine taking the gzFile is about to be called

examples.reason: failed gzclose_r leaves the handle open; after the successful gzclose_w a reopen precedes the next use
gzopen64 opens the handle like gzopen; gzgetc_ is a use like gzgetc

properties.rule: zlib.h crc32_combine_op: 'op is generated from len2 by crc32_combine_gen()'. crc32.c multmodp() loops forever when op is 0, so calling crc32_combine_op with no generated op hangs.

combine_op.meaning: crc32_combine_op is about to be called

examples.reason: an operator exists and may be reused
